purpose: Teach: 気功/狂牛病/磁場/下水道/社会保険庁/地表/脱臼/精油

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中国伝統の気功療法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on traditional Chinese qigong therapy, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone—she's testing gently. Conversational lilt, like she's checking in. Patient opening, with a slight rise at the end that invites him to correct her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、狂牛病パンデミックの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote mine on the history of mad cow disease pandemics.
lines.style: Quiet, almost apologetic correction. Slight hesitation before the pivot, like he's braced for her reaction. Even pacing, a touch of self-consciousness underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地球磁場の変動研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on researching fluctuations in Earth's magnetic field, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, curious tone—she's watching for his reaction. A patient teacher checking in. Slight emphasis on the question, warm but observant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の下水道整備史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, mine was on the history of postwar sewage system development.
lines.style: Soft, careful response. A beat of acceptance before answering—he's resigned to not matching her expectations. Steady voice, no defensiveness, just matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会保険庁の不祥事史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You researched the scandal history of the Social Insurance Agency, didn't you?
lines.style: Direct but curious—she's leaning in slightly. Alert engagement, like she's genuinely interested in what he'll say next. Warm professional tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地表温度の長期変動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I looked at long-term fluctuations in surface temperature.
lines.style: Steady answer, no apology this time. He's settling into the pattern. Level voice, clear and straightforward, almost relieved to just state the fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、肩関節脱臼のリハビリ研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you examined rehabilitation research on shoulder dislocation, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle probe again. Thoughtful pacing, like she's giving him space to respond. Warm curiosity underneath, no rush in her delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ラベンダー精油の鎮静効果研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually I researched the calming effects of lavender essential oil.
lines.style: A small, quiet ending. Settling voice like he's accepted this pattern between them. Slight fadeout on the last words, peaceful and accepting.
